name: Saibansi Bhakta Niwas (Shirdi Sansthan)
why_special: The official Sai Baba Sansthan Trust accommodation — 3,300+ rooms across Saibansi/New Bhakta Niwas/Sai Ashram complexes adjacent to the Samadhi Mandir. The default pilgrim bed at sansthan rates (₹150–₹2,500), bookable on the official online.sai.org.in portal.

name: Sun-n-Sand Shirdi
why_special: Sun-n-Sand Group's Shirdi 5-star 800 m from Samadhi Mandir — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine vegetarian restaurant Spice Garden, the polished pilgrim-hotel pick for families wanting 5-star service near the temple.

name: St. Laurn Suites Shirdi
why_special: St. Laurn Group's Shirdi 4-star with 100 suites 500 m from the Samadhi Mandir — outdoor pool, vegetarian multi-cuisine restaurant, the suite-pick for pilgrim families that want bigger rooms over a 5-star tag.
